shots.note: Chats — the session list read from the rollout files, and the composer's exact codex invocation
Console — codex exec with its flags as Material controls and the composed argv beneath them
Extend — the MCP servers read from config.toml, each with the command it runs
Extend ▸ Feature flags — every key the CLI exposes, filtered live
Config — a config.toml section with the live preview of the TOML it will write
Cost — the same workload priced against every model, with the sidebar marking the ones it has no price for
Runtime — one WSL instance per tab, each with the wsl.exe command that tab would run
Health ▸ Doctor — what `codex doctor --json` reported, with ok, warning and failing states distinguished
Health ▸ Usage — real token counts read from the newest session's last token_count event
Health ▸ Cloud tasks — what `codex cloud list` actually reported
History — every change the app made, filterable by date, by action and by text at once
History ▸ filtered — the action chips are derived from the log itself, with a count beside each
Changelog viewer — every released version, with bold and code spans rendered rather than printed
Changelog date filter — the anchored calendar, with the range highlighted and presets beside it
Studio settings — language mode, the two independent funny sliders, narrator, dim sum, editor
Regex builder anchored beside the search bar that opened it, matching the values that field filters
Per-element appearance editor — the two-dimensional colour field and the twelve-space translator

The same editor scrolled to its end — the continuous colour field and hue strip, the twelve-space translator, the live contrast readout, and the three properties this build cannot represent, each with its reason
Corner notification stack and the reviewable centre — both visible at once, neither covering the other
Bulk close preview — the one place a blocking dialog is correct, with the affected tabs listed first
Command palette — every screen, profile, session, setting and flag, searchable with its own regex builder
Dim sum surprise — a bundled catalog photo, non-blocking and auto-dismissing, drawn 1% of launches
Light theme — the same surface under the M3 light palette
Bilingual mode at funny level 5 — the rail, the headings and the empty state all localised
The two funny sliders in 廣東話 — one per language, each independently persisted
